Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator attempted to open the Excel file using an incorrect path (/Users/icyfeather/...) instead of the verified path (/Users/user_name/...). This unverified path prevented extracting the table captions early on, led to later unsubstantiated “facts” about the file’s contents, and caused the workflow to loop on web searches without the necessary local data, resulting in failure to produce the required reference number list.
